title: Observatory Instruments UI kit
sourcePolicy: Retain generated source bytes unchanged. Transparent output requested for every source. Exports may only crop transparent padding, fit proportionally and resample; no creative repainting.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent production game UI emblem for the native iOS game STARFALL. References are STYLE ONLY: celestial observatory craftsmanship, midnight enamel, delicate aged brass, warm pearl light, tiny accents of cool moonlight. Create ONE isolated emblem, centered on a square transparent canvas with generous clear padding. Sculpted hand-painted high-quality game icon, direct front view with very slight material depth, crisp readable silhouette. Shared light source upper left. It must read at 40 points: simplify fine detail, use large clean shapes, restrained glow close to the object, no detached sparkles. No background, no floor/shadow, no circular badge/frame, no text, no letters, no numbers, no face, no UI button. Fully visible entire object, no clipping, true RGBA transparency. Subject: a small hanging observatory lantern, upright, with one fine brass suspension loop, short tiered midnight-blue cap, rounded amber glass chamber holding a warm four-ray pearl light, thin brass ribs and a small taper below. Elegant compact silhouette, the glass is warm and softly luminous while the brass is restrained. No ornate wings or tiny filigree.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready blank UI skin for the native game STARFALL, delivered as ONE isolated straight-on object on real transparent RGBA background. Use the reference for midnight-blue enamel and warm brass MATERIAL only. Mature subtle game craftsmanship. Extremely thin aged brass edge, very shallow bevel, restrained upper-left warm light, dark nearly uniform matte navy enamel fill. No bright bloom, no continuous neon glow, no big chunky jewelry rim. NO text, letters, symbols, icons, labels, detached stars, objects, scenery or cast. Not a screenshot or specimen sheet. No drop shadow extending outside the silhouette. Symmetric planar front view, no perspective, no tilt. Clean regular geometry and fully opaque continuous dark center. Plenty of transparent margin; every edge is fully contained. Crisp anti-aliased perimeter. Corners and tiny fittings stay fixed while the blank middle is designed to stretch. Subject: a single horizontal action button skin, exactly three times as wide as tall, placed horizontally in the center of the canvas. Rounded/chamfered capsule corners, two small restrained diamond brass joints at the extreme left and right only. Use two VERY thin shallow brass outlines with a dark gap, rather than a thick gold frame. A broad completely plain unpatterned dark enamel interior covers at least the central 65 percent of the width and 60 percent of height, reserved for native text. The long top and bottom edges are perfectly straight, quiet and uniform through the entire middle; no central shine, notch, crest or diamond. Art should read with about a one-point brass rim when shown at 160x56 points. No inner stars or decorative speckles.
